Ministry sub-page about DIT; resolves hosting only, adds nothing beyond dit.gov.mk.

State statistics office: NACE K employment and wage series, the sector baseline for bank-level cuts.
URL is an unrelated tracker-style domain with a key param, not a credible open-data mirror of stat.gov.mk.
ITUC country page gives recurring union-rights and bargaining-coverage signals for triangulation.
UNI Europa Finance sector hub tracks CEE finance-union bargaining and cross-border bank restructuring.
Highest hit-density wire for MK bank board/CEO appointments, but SeeNews content is largely subscription-gated.
IntelliNews MK desk covers banking and payments leadership/market entries; most articles sit behind a paywall.
IMF country hub publishes recurring Article IV reports on supervisory capacity and staffing.
Generic global FSAP programme page, not an MK-specific feed; mine once for the MK assessment PDFs.
Annual EC enlargement report page: dated assessments of supervisory capacity and SEPA-driven payments change.
Third-party mirror of EC PDFs; only value is URL-rotation fallback and archiving superseded editions.
EBRD country hub yields strategy/diagnostic/Transition Report material on bank ownership and governance reform.
Fitch entity page scores management and governance for MK sovereign/banks; registration required for full RACs.
Moody's homepage-level entry; parent-group credit opinions are relevant but login-gated and need a narrower entry URL.
